# Reacher AI

> Reacher AI is a marketing agent with a built-in multi-agent research engine (Research Ninja). It plans, searches, reads and critiques sources, then writes on-brand content, campaigns and publishable research reports. Every public report shows its sources, a critic score and what the run cost.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://reacher-ai.lovable.app/): product overview
- Public research reports live at https://reacher-ai.lovable.app/r/{slug} and are listed in the sitemap.
